modes.label: Number prefix in a compound
modes.description: Two, tri or tw begins a word about groups of two or three, such as two-drive, triad or twins.

card.plain: It fires on the 'multi-' or 'two-' start of a compound, predicting an ending like 'body' or 'party'.
